scope: Woodford, Interest and Prices, Chapter 8: Optimal Policy Rules, with Appendix G. The general LQ setup and first-order conditions with the target-criterion construction via adjugates (Props 8.1-8.4 as hypothesis structures, general theory deferred); optimal inflation targeting under inflation inertia, sticky wages (exact determinacy region for kappa_w /= kappa_p with counterexample), habit persistence, predetermined pricing, the Giannoni-Woodford model, imperfect information and reflections; optimal interest-rate rules: Prop 8.5 determinacy for all admissible parameters via a palindromic root count and Prop 8.6 forward integration; the inflation-inertia model: Prop 8.7 root structure, Lemmas G.1-G.2, Prop 8.8 Rules I-III over the complex numbers with determinacy of the rule system, Props 8.9-8.11 representations and limits, Figs 8.3-8.5 numbers including the .39 enclosure. Book misprints and false claims are corrected with Lean counterexamples.
source: Michael Woodford, Interest and Prices: Foundations of a Theory of Monetary Policy, Princeton University Press, 2003, Chapter 8, pp. 534-623, and Appendix G, pp. 716-745.
